programmes.d: Witness the events that turned ace U-boat commander Otto Kretschmer from Nazi idol to prisoner of war.
Enter The Devil's Gorge with two Allied convoys on a collision course with the largest Nazi wolf pack ever assembled.
See how a new wave of aggressive U.S. sub commanders radically changed the Navy's WWII strategy, and in turn, the war.
One of Holland America Line's largest cruisers makes its debut in the Caribbean, highlighted by a visit to an exclusive private island resort.
Costa Diadema's seven-day cruise around the Mediterranean offers Italian delights to its passengers and challenges to its captain and crew.
The world's latest, most-advanced expedition cruise ship Roald Amundsen whisks passengers on an adventurous voyage to Antarctica.
We hop aboard a seven-day cruise to the Canary Islands and Madeira aboard the first large liner to run purely on cleaner-burning liquefied natural gas.
Discover how little companies with astronomical dreams are stepping into the void left by the Space Shuttle's demise.
See how risky trial and error by Space Age pioneers paved the way for today's Mars landing and other breakthroughs.
Buzz Aldrin, Jim Lovell, and NASA experts discuss the Apollo missions and look into the future of deep space exploration.
Discover how a mission to the Red Planet is no longer the stuff of science fiction, but is quickly becoming a reality.
A look at the immigrant experience in America during the early 1900s, told through colorized home movies and archival footage.
Revisit America during the turbulent 1960s, as we bring the dawn of modern America to colorful life.
The story of Alaska's evolution, from isolated wilderness to America's 49th state, during the first half of the 20th century.
A look at the charms and challenges of small town life in America during the first half of the 20th century, presented entirely in color.
A look at the Hindenburg crash, the San Francisco earthquake and other disasters of the early 20th century through colorized home movies and archival footage.
Watch the Model T roll out, the Jazz Age erupt, and the market crash, as it has never been seen before: in color.
Color footage of the Rockefellers, Roosevelts, and Kennedys gives an unprecedented look at America's storied families.
Grab a front row seat to a fully colorized look at Hollywood's Golden Age.
